description:
Full listing of a space: description, coworking and venue, address, capacity, prices per hour/day/week/month, amenities, opening hours, rating and reviews.

Accepts `space_id` or `slug` (`search_coworks` returns both). If you already know the date or the number of people, pass them: the booking link comes prefilled.

currency.description: Currency of the returned prices (default usd).

date.description: Date YYYY-MM-DD, to prefill the booking link.

ends_at.description: End time HH:MM. Requires `starts_at` and must be later.

spots.description: Number of people, to prefill the booking link.

starts_at.description: Start time HH:MM. Hourly bookings only; requires `ends_at`.

utm_source.description: MCP client that originates the request, for attribution of the booking URL (e.g. 'claude', 'chatgpt'). Default 'mcp_unknown'.

name: cowork_detail

id.description: Space identifier. Pass it as `space_id` to `check_availability` or `get_booking_link`.

prices.description: List prices per unit, already converted to `currency`.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the venue.

title: Space details
